language_task: Pick up the block and place it on the cardboard.
outcome_evidence: At frame 0, camera_high shows the green block on the white surface beside the cardboard. Frames 290–350 in camera_wrist_right show the block retained between the fingers while camera_high shows it transported toward the cardboard. The robot lowers it over the cardboard in frames 480–630; in frames 633–749, camera_wrist_right shows the fingers separating and the block remaining on the cardboard, corroborated by camera_high. No failed acquisition, unintended collision, or other side effect is visibly established.
